info.name: VNUIS Asset Maintenance DSS API
info.description:
Complete API collection for VNUIS Asset Maintenance Decision Support System.

## Roles
- **Manager** (manager.e@vnu.edu.vn) - Full admin access
- **Technician** (tech.c@vnu.edu.vn) - Work order management
- **User** (lecturer.a@vnu.edu.vn) - Fault reporting

## Getting Started
1. Login with one of the accounts above (password: 123456)
2. Copy the token from login response
3. Set the `token` variable in collection variables
4. Or use role-specific tokens: `manager_token`, `technician_token`, `user_token`

item.name: 🔐 Auth
